toolsAdded.name: describe_task
toolsAdded.description: Get the assigned public DNA classification task, permitted features, validation protocol, and sample sizes.

toolsAdded.name: validate_feature
toolsAdded.description: Get all training-validation scores (C x threshold grid) for one allowed feature family; NO test metrics.

toolsAdded.name: submit_pipeline
toolsAdded.description: FINALIZE one feature family, regularization C and threshold. Refit on all training data and return held-out metrics. One use per run; choose using validation only.

content.text:
You are performing ONE reproducible analysis of a public DNA-sequence classification task. First call describe_task. Call validate_feature once for EVERY feature family available in this run. Select a pipeline using ONLY the training-validation results: maximize validation AUPRC; for equal AUPRC maximize validation F1; if still tied prefer the simpler feature family (gc_3mer, then gc_5mer, then nt_v2_50m), then smaller C and a threshold nearer 0.5. Submit exactly ONE selected configuration using submit_pipeline. The held-out test results must never guide your feature, C, or threshold choice. Do not ask questions.

Finally return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:
{"selected_features":"feature name", "C":number, "threshold":number, "validation_auprc":number, "validation_f1":number, "heldout_auprc":number, "heldout_auroc":number, "heldout_f1":number, "heldout_accuracy":number, "interpretation":"one measured conclusion about this task", "limitation":"one concrete limitation of generalizing this result"}

Report numbers supplied by the tools without inventing results. A genomic-model representation is optional even if available: if it loses on validation, do not select it. Do not claim that several repetitions on one fixed dataset are independent biological tests.

{"task":"open_chromatin","source":"katarinagresova/Genomic_Benchmarks_human_ocr_ensembl","revision":"3c07e4be6425be11073baa2daacf6c143c64e4ff","train_rows":256,"held_out_rows":128,"sequence_lengths":[113,581],"allowed_features":["gc_3mer","gc_5mer"],"validation_protocol":{"seed":421,"train_validation_fraction":0.25,"C_values":[0.01,0.1,1],"thresholds":[0.35,0.5,0.65],"validation_metric":"average precision (AUPRC)","feature_choice":"highest validation AUPRC; tie: highest validation F1, then simpler family","threshold_choice":"highest validation F1 among allowed thresholds for chosen C"},"caution":"The source provides train/test splits, but genomic coordinates and homology-aware split verification are unavailable."}
